important_note: Final globally balanced Trouble Brewing recommendation pool. Official examples remain hard anchors; external references are soft references. Every Drunk preset contains exactly three legal absent Townsfolk in `drunk_as_options`; non-Drunk presets contain an empty list.

small_game_policy.5_6_players: Use the normal small-game/Teensyville starting-information rules unless a Fabled such as Toymaker changes them. The default curated 5-6 pools intentionally omit Baron; Baron remains rules-legal but is unusually distorting at these counts.

runtime_selection_policy.similarity_scope: Compare real in-play non-Demon role IDs. Imp is excluded because it is always present in Trouble Brewing.
extra_soft_penalties: same minion set as the immediately previous game
same primary style tag as several recent games
same Drunk disguise in consecutive games when Drunk is present
runtime_selection_policy.fallback: If filtering leaves no candidates, relax the overlap threshold by 0.05 repeatedly, then choose randomly.

curation_policy.external_references: reviewed soft references; selected only when compatible with global distribution and local gameplay-quality objectives
local_quality_model: balance among first-night information, ongoing/triggered information, and active/defensive/public/endgame Townsfolk abilities
maintain useful information flow without allowing information ability types to dominate by default
reward meaningful Trouble Brewing interactions modestly
avoid exact duplicate setups and rely on runtime rotation for recent-game similarity
curation_policy.townsfolk_frequency_policy: per player count: blend 50% prior curated marginal distribution with 50% neutral/equal marginal distribution, then optimize local gameplay quality

candidate_rules: must be absent from the actual in-play Townsfolk
drunk_shown_role_policy.distribution_policy: follow the natural legal-opportunity distribution across the finalized global setup pool, with per-player-count coverage and local experience diversity used to choose among legal alternatives
drunk_shown_role_policy.triple_repetition_policy: all 208 Drunk presets use unique option triples
